# Security

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report it privately: **Security → Report a vulnerability** in this repository
([direct link](https://github.com/MOJI6416/lumovio-web/security/advisories/new)). Don't open a public issue.

This covers the code here and the service at [lumovio.app](https://lumovio.app), including its private backend. Say
what you found, where (an address or a file), the steps to reproduce it and what it lets someone do.

Please:

- test only with accounts you own; don't open, change or delete anyone else's data, and stop and report as soon as you
  see someone else's;
- no denial of service, spam, social engineering or scanning that loads the service;
- give us time to fix it before you tell anyone.

Media servers people connect to Lumovio (Jellyfin, Plex, TorrServer) are theirs: report their own issues to those
projects.

A fix goes to lumovio.app first and reaches this repository with the next export.

## Not for this form

- Help with an account or with playback: [lumovio.app/support](https://lumovio.app/support).
- A rights holder's notice about a title: [lumovio.app/legal/copyright](https://lumovio.app/legal/copyright).
